den-agents.role: Agent workstation, Proxmox VM 100 on den-prox
den-agents.notes: No Proxmox guest backup job covers this VM, and its 2 TB /data disk is backup=0. Project files are covered by den-agents-git. The thin host configuration backups and the Ops collector also run here.

den-nas.notes: Configuration and small app state: den-nas-config. Bulk media is protected only by SnapRAID parity (den-nas-snapraid), which is not a backup.

den-k8.notes: Configuration only: den-k8-config. No whole-machine backup.

den-win11.notes: Configuration, Sunshine and Enshrouded saves only: den-win11-config. No whole-machine backup.

den-prox.notes: Host configuration: den-prox-config. It has no Proxmox guest backup job.

den-prox-mini.notes: Host configuration: den-prox-mini-config. Its guest backups are the den-prox-mini-vzdump-* jobs.

github.notes: Default-branch source ZIPs of the configured repositories are archived on den-nas daily (github-archives). Git history, local uncommitted files, LFS payloads and submodule repositories are not in those ZIPs.

den-agents-git.scope: Git repositories with working trees, worktrees, submodules, alternates and LFS stores
den-agents-git.notes: Runner: den-agents-backup.timer 07:00 Pacific, start window 07:00-10:00. Borg exit 1 is a warning, 2 a failure.

den-agents-git-maintenance.scope: Compact and check the repository and latest archive; the first Saturday of a month also reads all data and runs the restore test
den-agents-git-maintenance.notes: Runner: den-agents-backup-maintenance.timer. Its checks are also recorded on den-agents-git.

den-nas-config.source: den-nas /etc, NAS scripts, Compose files and small app databases (allowlist)
den-nas-config.scope: Configuration and small persistent app state; no media, downloads or recordings
den-nas-config.notes: Runner: den-config-backup.service, started by the 07:00 Git timer. Each run restores the new archive locally and checks it.

den-k8-config.source: den-k8 /etc, agent dotfiles and tool settings (allowlist)
den-k8-config.notes: Runner: den-config-backup.service, started by the 07:00 Git timer.

den-win11-config.source: den-win11 OpenSSH, Sunshine, Enshrouded server and saves, scheduled task XML (allowlist)
den-win11-config.scope: Configuration and small saves; no installed programs or games
den-win11-config.notes: Runner: den-config-backup.service, started by the 07:00 Git timer.

den-prox-config.source: den-prox /etc (with /etc/pve), pmxcfs config.db snapshot, cloud-init snippets, inventories
den-prox-config.scope: Proxmox host configuration; no guest disks or dumps
den-prox-config.notes: Runner: den-config-backup.service. The restore check verifies the pmxcfs database for node den-prox.

den-prox-mini-config.source: den-prox-mini /etc (with /etc/pve), pmxcfs config.db snapshot, October 2 recovery files, inventories
den-prox-mini-config.scope: Proxmox host configuration; no guest disks or dumps
den-prox-mini-config.notes: Runner: den-config-backup.service. The restore check verifies the pmxcfs database for node prox.

host-configs-nas-copy.scope: Cold copy of the whole configuration Borg repository and its recovery key
host-configs-nas-copy.notes: A busy NAS maintenance lock defers the copy (warning) and keeps the previous generation; the last success shows the age of the current copy.

den-nas-snapraid.scope: Parity sync daily; Sunday also scrubs 25% of the array. Storage maintenance, not a backup.
den-nas-snapraid.recovery_pointer: den-nas /etc/snapraid.conf; content files on each data disk
den-nas-snapraid.notes: Runner: snapraid-daily.timer (Mon-Sat) and snapraid-weekly.timer (Sun) at 08:00 Pacific via /usr/local/bin/snapraid-maintenance.sh. Log: /var/log/snapraid-maintenance.log.
